segments.normalizedSource: ```other def Xform "Root" ( # Because you can apply `kind` to any type of prim, that allows any prim to be a scene. kind = "sceneLibrary" ) { # `PrimaryScene` is immediately active due to the `def` keyword. def Xform "PrimaryScene" ( # `sceneName` can be any human-readable string. sceneName = "Primary Scene" ) { } # `SecondaryScene` is inactive due to the over keyword. over Xform "SecondaryScene" ( sceneName = "Secondary Scene" ) { } } ```
